```py
from scipy import stats

# define variables for x, n, and p
n = 5
p = 0.6
x = 2

# use scipy to compute the pmf
p_x = stats.binom.pmf(x, n, p)

# use the probability for future work
print(f'P(X = {x}) = {p_x}')
```
